title: Will the Senate vote on any motion, resolution, or order whose adoption would begin or provide for the Senate’s scheduled August 2026 break, including through pro forma sessions?

markets.title: Will the Senate vote on any motion, resolution, or order whose adoption would begin or provide for the Senate’s scheduled August 2026 break, including through pro forma sessions?
markets.rules_primary: If the Senate has conducted any recorded vote on any motion, resolution, or order whose adoption would begin or provide for the Senate’s scheduled August 2026 break, including through pro forma sessions after Issuance and before Aug 10, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This includes:
Roll call votes
Recorded votes
Yea-and-nay votes
Electronic votes (in the House)
Division/standing votes

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Voice votes where individual member positions are not recorded
Unanimous consent agreements without a recorded vote
Votes in committee, unless the bill/motion specifically refers to a committee vote
Procedural determinations by the presiding officer
Deemed passage without an actual vote

For clarity:
A vote on cloture regarding the bill/motion, including cloture on a motion to proceed to the bill/motion, DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on the rule governing debate of the bill/motion DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion if the bill/motion specifically refers to that rule
A vote on a motion to proceed to the bill/motion DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on final passage DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on an amendment to the bill/motion does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion unless the bill/motion specifically refers to that amendment
